summary: Inmune Bio Inc. filed an 8-K regarding a warrant inducement letter and amendment with certain holders of April 2024 warrants. Holders exercised 50% of their warrants (647,112 shares) at a reduced price of $1.40/share (from $1.95), generating ~$0.91M cash. The remaining 50% warrants had their maturity extended from June 30, 2026 to December 31, 2027. The inducement is a routine financing adjustment, not a special situation. Watch for potential dilution from unexercised warrants; no material change in control or corporate structure.
